description: Crescent Fibres Limited is a Pakistan Stock Exchange-listed spinner that began operations in 1969 and today runs its textile division from two units, at Bhikki in Sheikhupura district, Punjab, and at Nooriabad in Sindh. The company operates 76,176 spindles and specialises in high value-added polyester/cotton, chief value cotton (CVC) and pure cotton yarns, with capacity for 22 million pounds of ring-spun yarn a year. Its original wood-related and chemical divisions have since been discontinued.

products.name: 65/35 polyester-cotton yarn

products.name: 52/48 polyester-cotton yarn
